items.title: Parsa police arrest 103 convicted fugitives in a month
items.desc: Police say the arrests will help enforce court rulings against people who had evaded prison terms and fines.

items.title: Movie review: ‘12 Gaun 2’ delivers the fights but forgets the story
items.desc: Biraj Bhatta’s sequel is weighed down by a disjointed plot, underwritten characters and a villain whose portrayal leans on a damaging stereotype.

items.title: For Timure’s flood survivors, Dashain brings memories of the lives they lost
items.desc: Displaced by the Bhotekoshi flood, 111 families are spending the festival in a Kathmandu monastery, grieving loved ones and wondering when they can return home.

items.title: As France erupts, Europe’s far right gains from fuel-price anger ahead of elections
items.desc: Surging energy costs and a deepening cost-of-living crisis are fuelling protests across the continent, giving far-right parties fresh momentum as they call for tax cuts and a return to Russian energy supplies ahead of key elections.

items.title: Two killed in wild elephant attack in Jhapa
items.desc: A 73-year-old man and a 70-year-old woman were attacked while out on a morning walk in Barhadashi Rural Municipality.

items.title: Far from home, Dashain carries a different kind of ache
items.desc: In Japan, a Nepali migrant celebrates with friends beside Hiroshima’s Motoyasu river, finding a sense of belonging while longing for family, home and a father who will never welcome him back.

items.title: In Gorkha’s flood-hit villages, even cooking a meal is a struggle
items.desc: The Budhigandaki flood destroyed homes and disrupted road links, leaving families dependent on limited helicopter deliveries for food and other essentials.

items.title: Devotees throng Taleju Bhawani temple on Maha Navami
items.desc: Open to the public only once a year, the temple in Kathmandu’s Hanuman Dhoka Durbar complex draws large crowds of worshippers during Dashain.

items.title: Musk pledges SpaceX shares to every child in America amid scrutiny of Big Tech
items.desc: The billionaire’s proposal follows Anthropic’s plan to commit at least 5 percent of its shares to social causes, as the technology industry faces growing criticism over AI’s impact on jobs and society.

items.title: Ronaldo handed 30-day ban for leaving Portugal camp following coach Jesus rift
items.desc: The Portuguese FA also fined the 41-year-old forward €255 after upholding a charge over his departure from the national team camp following a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the side.

items.title: Baglung flood survivors face Dashain without homes as rebuilding stalls
items.desc: Families in Baglung are living in a cooperative building, relatives’ homes and a buffalo shed after floods swept away their houses and farmland. Many struggle to secure land and meet government requirements for reconstruction aid.

items.title: Tourist arrivals in Mustang plunge 41.5 percent
items.desc: Floods, heavy rain and prolonged closure of the Beni-Jomsom road disrupt access to the Himalayan district during the autumn tourism season.

items.title: Nepal hold off Oman for 10-run victory in League 2
items.desc: Rohit Paudel, Dipendra Singh Airee and Dev Khanal hit half-centuries as Nepal defend a target of 281 to claim their third win of the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 series.

items.title: Festival imports help Birgunj customs beat monthly target
items.desc: The border office collected Rs26.73 billion in revenue from mid-September to mid-October, exceeding its target of Rs26.46 billion as imports rose ahead of Dashain, Tihar and Chhath.

items.title: Three detained over shooting at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s car
items.desc: The actor escaped without gunshot wounds in the Mumbai attack, while police investigate an unverified claim linking the shooting to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang.

items.title: The swings that bring Dashain to life
items.desc: As families return to their villages for the festival, traditional swings draw crowds and add to the festive spirit.

items.title: Nepal set Oman 281-run target after Paudel-Airee rescue act
items.desc: Their record 139-run fourth-wicket stand helped Nepal recover from an early collapse in a must-win Cricket World Cup League 2 match.

items.title: Paras Khadka came close to quitting cricket three years before retiring
items.desc: The former captain of Nepal’s national cricket team recalls how Karan KC and Sandeep Lamichhane’s last-wicket heroics against Canada in 2018 kept the team’s ODI dream alive.

items.title: Two teenagers injured as conflict-era bomb explodes in Jumla
items.desc: Gunpowder inside an old iron pipe ignited as the youths tried to cut it for use in a water tap.

items.title: Dashain homecomings bring a new wave of visitors to Ramaroshan
items.desc: Nepalis returning from cities and abroad are adding trips to Achham’s lakes and alpine meadows to their festival plans, but poor roads and limited accommodation remain obstacles.

items.title: Should we feel guilty about celebrating Dashain this year?
items.desc: As families gather for Dashain, many are asking whether joy is insensitive when others are still searching, mourning and rebuilding. Psychology says joy and compassion can coexist.

items.title: Bangladesh is battling measles. It’s a “real warning” to other nations
items.desc: More than 1,100 people have died, most of them children under five, as gaps in vaccination coverage, unreliable data and failures to reach remote communities undermine Bangladesh’s response to the outbreak.

items.title: Family alleges abuse after man dies two days into rehab stay
items.desc: Relatives have filed a police complaint against the operator of a rehabilitation centre in Jhapa, alleging CCTV footage shows the 33-year-old man restrained and beaten. Police are investigating the circumstances of his death.

items.title: As old Dashain customs fade, the village swing holds high
items.desc: In Ramechhap, traditional linge ping swings are reconnecting families, preserving festival traditions, and finding new life on social media.

items.title: For evicted squatters, Dashain brings little to celebrate
items.desc: Six months after losing their homes, families from Kathmandu’s Thapathali and Shankhamul settlements remain in holding centres, struggling without jobs or a clear path to permanent housing.

items.title: How Nepal played a big role in South Africa’s liberation
items.desc: Anil Sooklal, South Africa’s top envoy to Nepal, on apartheid-era solidarity, climate justice after the Rasuwa flood, and why Kathmandu and Cape Town should be twinned.

items.title: What Dashain asks of us this year
items.desc: From swollen rivers to crowded highways, this year’s Dashain calls for as much care as celebration.

items.title: Slay, cringe, scroll, repeat
items.desc: Orwell feared a vocabulary too flat to think in. We managed it ourselves, for free, with filters.
